annotations.text:
StartupIndex — redesign

Same parchment-and-ink instrument, rebuilt on tokens that hold up:
· five hues, one job each, all ≥4.6:1 on every surface in both themes
· six type steps replacing fourteen ad-hoc sizes, floor 9px → 11px
· one brand name, one label idiom, one radius
· channel identity = hue + two-character sigil, so the trace survives grayscale
Tokens board is the spec the implementation follows — every value here is lifted straight into globals.css.
